# BTicino C300X Integration v2.8.1

## 2026-11-22

[![Support me on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/oliver7557)

## Display restore without a false error

Restoring the Display patch no longer reports `display_library_restore_failed`
after it has put the display library back. Agent commands on the C300X lost
their output when it went to a pipe, so the Display patch script read nothing
from the agent. Needs the agent update.

## The speaker says what it does

The speaker media player shows **Ready** or **Playing** with a matching icon,
and its last result in words instead of a code, for example **Interrupted by a
call or camera view** when a ring or the camera view ended a sound.

## Clearer settings

- **Activations:** the step says that further door locks and lights, for
  example for a second door, are added there, one activation each.
- **Visitor snapshot size:** the form explains the limit. The picture is read
  from the 800×480 display, so it is at most 480 high; for a 704×576 camera
  picture, about 587×480 keeps its shape. The error for an invalid size says
  the same.
